top_signals.title: Paramount Fundamentally Hard Story to Invest In: Lloyd
top_signals.summary: Annie Seelaus, CEO of R. Seelaus, and John Lloyd, global head of multi-sector and corporate credit at Janus Henderson, join Emily Graffeo on "Bloomberg Real Yield." This week Paramount Skydance  issued $52 billion of debt to fund the biggest Hollywood buyout ever. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Accenture shares surge as consulting giant shrugs off worst of AI fears
top_signals.summary: Shares in consulting giant Accenture surged on Thursday after the firm topped its own revenue targets and shrugged off the worst fears of an AI-induced slowdown. The New-York listed consultant said fourth-quarter revenues rose by six per cent to $18.7bn [£14.1bn], outpacing its own target of between $17.7bn [£13.4bn] to $18.4bn [£13.9bn]. top_signals.title: UK Holds Emergency Talks With U.S. as Diesel Crisis Escalates
top_signals.summary: Energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh is holding crunch talks with her American counterpart over Donald Trump’s threat to curb diesel exports to Europe. City AM understands that Fahnbulleh is in direct contact with US energy secretary Chris Wright to discuss a US move to potentially choke off diesel exports to Europe that threatens to upend supply and send prices at the pump soaring, a person familiar with the discussions said.
